en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a harbor scene on a river. Several long barges or riverboats with tall masts are moored along the bank, with people visible working on the boats. In the background there is a tree-lined shore and a prominent multi‑storey house or inn on the right. The printed caption at the top reads "Mühlberg (Elbe) – Hafen," indicating this is the harbor of Mühlberg on the Elbe River.
